entities.summary: Valeriya Sergeevna Kozlova (Russian: Валерия Сергеевна Козлова;, better known as Lera Kozlova, is a Russian musician most famous for her work with the pop-rock band Ranetki where she provided the vocals and played the drums. She is also the former vocalist of the band 5sta Family.
